title: When a companion quarrel fires ('They both look at you'), the room itself offers no immediate way to respond — the actual resolution option ('back her — a promise is a promise', 'back Tamsin — the Watch keeps its honor') only appears later, buried inside that companion's own full talk-tree, mixed in with unrelated evergreen topics (e.g. 'call her brother a deserter', 'ask what really drives her'). A player who doesn't think to reopen every companion's conversation after a quarrel could leave it permanently unaddressed without ever seeing that an option existed.
where: The Head-Frame (Cinderhall) quarrel -> resolved via 'talk to Lys' -> 'back her — a promise is a promise'; The Record-House (Wardmoor) quarrel -> resolved via 'talk to Tamsin' -> 'back Tamsin — the Watch keeps its honor'
